items.title: 颱風假圖片對比作文
items.prompt_zh: 根據對比圖片描述兩種不同情景（是否放颱風假），並說明個人看法與經驗（依114年學測英文題目考後總覽報導）。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段客觀對比兩張圖片：一張是放颱風假時學生在家輕鬆的畫面，一張是沒放假時大家冒著風雨通勤的畫面，不出現「我」。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段說明個人看法與經驗，例如支持安全優先於到課率、分享自己淋雨上學的經驗，收尾呼籲放假標準要一致透明。
ideas: 圖一：放假的學生開心地在家看電視、和家人在一起
圖二：沒放假時，學生和上班族在風雨中艱難通勤，道路淹水
看法：安全應該優先於到課率，只要有風雨警報就該果斷放假
經驗：自己曾經在沒放颱風假那天冒雨上學，鞋子全濕、上課也無心
看法：放假標準應該更透明一致，避免各地認定落差造成困擾
grammar: 第一段客觀對比兩張圖用現在式，不出現「我」，可用 In contrast/On the other hand 連接。
第二段轉主觀可用 From my own experience,.../In my view, safety should always come first.
可用附帶動作句型 S V with O Vpp 描寫淋雨畫面：trudging to school with their shoes soaked。
小心被動語態：the announcement was made too late（宣布得太晚）要用被動，不要主動被動混淆。

from_bank.sentence: The bar chart reveals some intriguing findings.
from_bank.why: N reveals... 可改成 The second photo reveals a striking contrast between a relaxed day off and a chaotic commute in the storm，用於第一段開場。

from_bank.sentence: She stepped into adulthood with all her savings gone.
from_bank.why: S V with O Vpp（附帶動作）可改成 Students trudged to school with their shoes soaked and their umbrellas broken，描寫沒放假時淋雨上學的畫面。

from_bank.sentence: Reluctant though I was to cut my entertainment budget, I did it anyway.
from_bank.why: 讓步倒裝可改成 Frustrating though the flooded streets were, many still had to make it to school on time，寫沒放颱風假時的無奈。

from_bank.sentence: After all, there is no single correct answer; what matters is finding the arrangement that fits one's own life.
from_bank.why: 收尾可改成 what matters most is that safety, not attendance, should decide whether school is called off。

common_mistakes: Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
a child who grow up → who grew up（時態要跟主詞的時間一致）
冠詞漏掉：In comparison with average Taiwanese adult → with the average Taiwanese adult；willing to allocate majority of salary → the majority of my salary
用語不精準：my income management may seem quite bizarre → unconventional（bizarre 語氣太重）；people coming to participate in the game → spectators（一個字取代一串修飾語，是拉分最快的方法）
guide.model_essay: The first photo shows students happily lounging at home, watching television while heavy rain falls safely outside their windows. The second, taken on a day without a typhoon day off, reveals a striking contrast: students trudging to school with their shoes soaked and their umbrellas broken, wading through flooded streets. From my own experience, I once had to commute to school through ankle-deep water because the announcement of no day off came too late for anyone to prepare. In my view, safety should always come first, and schools should be quicker to declare a day off during serious storm warnings. Frustrating though the flooded streets were that day, I made it to class only to find half of my classmates missing anyway. What matters most is that safety, not attendance, should decide whether school is called off, and that decision should be made early enough for families to plan.
model_essay_used: N reveals...（reveals a striking contrast）
附帶動作 with O Vpp（trudging to school with their shoes soaked and their umbrellas broken）
讓步倒裝 adj. though S V（Frustrating though the flooded streets were...）

items.title: 機器人幫手解決青少年問題
items.prompt_zh: 題目設定一款機器人幫手可協助解決青少年面臨的某項問題，考生須從選項中選擇一項問題，說明機器人可如何協助解決，並陳述理由（依113學測英文作文解析報導）。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段選一項青少年常見問題（例如時間管理不佳、容易拖延），說明機器人幫手可以怎麼協助解決這個問題。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段陳述理由，說明為什麼這個機器人幫手的協助方式有效或重要，例如比父母念更容易被接受。
ideas: 選擇問題：青少年常常拖延、時間管理不佳
機器人幫手功能：提醒待辦事項、規劃讀書時間表、適時提醒休息
機器人幫手功能：用溫和不說教的語氣提醒，比爸媽念更容易被接受
理由：青少年在意自主權，機器人建議而非命令，更容易被採納
理由：長期使用能培養時間管理的習慣，處理根本原因而非治標

phrases.en: break a task into smaller steps

grammar: 第一段先點名問題再說明機器人怎麼協助，可用 One problem worth solving is that... 開頭。
可用 not only...but also 說明機器人幫手的雙重功能，倒裝時動詞回原形。
第二段給理由可用 The reason this works is that.../This approach requires...but aligns with...
小心固定搭配：be inclined to V，不要接成 be inclined V。

from_bank.sentence: One phenomenon worth discussing is that the expenses of food only make up for 19%.
from_bank.why: 句型 One ... worth discussing/considering is that... 可改成 One problem worth solving is that many teenagers struggle to manage their own time，用於第一段開頭點題。

from_bank.sentence: I have sufficient reasons to pour tremendous expenses into education.
from_bank.why: I have sufficient reasons to V 可改成 I have sufficient reasons to believe that a personal robot assistant could solve this problem，用於第二段開頭表態。

from_bank.sentence: This strategy requires some short-term sacrifices but aligns with long-term goals.
from_bank.why: 可改成 This approach requires some initial setup but aligns with building a lasting habit of managing time well。

from_bank.sentence: After all, there is no single correct answer; what matters is finding the arrangement that fits one's own life.
from_bank.why: 收尾可改成 what matters is helping teenagers build the habit for themselves，收掉『幫手是輔助而非取代自律』的重點。

common_mistakes: 冠詞漏掉：In comparison with average Taiwanese adult → with the average Taiwanese adult；willing to allocate majority of salary → the majority of my salary

Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
用語不精準：my income management may seem quite bizarre → unconventional（bizarre 語氣太重）；people coming to participate in the game → spectators（一個字取代一串修飾語，是拉分最快的方法）
自創字：savement → savings；recreate → recreation（不確定的字不要自己造，換一個百分之百會的字）
guide.model_essay: One problem worth solving is that many teenagers struggle to manage their own time, often procrastinating until deadlines are dangerously close. A personal robot assistant could help by breaking large tasks into smaller steps and sending gentle reminders throughout the day, without ever sounding like a nagging parent. Not only would it keep track of assignments, but it could also suggest short breaks to prevent burnout, learning each teenager's habits over time. I have sufficient reasons to believe that this kind of quiet, non-judgmental support would work better than being told what to do. Teenagers value their independence, and a suggestion feels far more acceptable than a command. This approach requires some initial setup but aligns with building a lasting habit of managing time well. After all, a robot assistant should not replace self-discipline; what matters is helping teenagers build that habit for themselves, one small reminder at a time.
model_essay_used: One...worth Ving is that...（One problem worth solving is that...）
not only...but also（Not only would it keep track of assignments, but it could also suggest...）
I have sufficient reasons to V（I have sufficient reasons to believe that...）

items.title: 表情符號emoji使用
items.prompt_zh: 隨著社群媒體普及，表情符號使用極為普遍。第一段需說明人們為何喜歡使用表情符號，並舉一至二例說明其溝通功能；第二段以個人或親友經驗為例，討論表情符號可能造成的誤會或困擾，並提出化解方法。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段說明人們為何喜歡使用表情符號，並舉一到二例說明其溝通功能，例如表達語氣、節省打字時間、增加親切感。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段以個人或親友經驗為例，描述表情符號造成的誤會或困擾，並提出化解方法。
ideas: 表情符號能快速傳達情緒，補足文字缺乏語氣的問題
例如一個笑臉可以讓提醒的話聽起來不那麼嚴肅
誤會案例：同一個表情符號在不同人眼中解讀不同，曾被朋友誤會語帶諷刺
化解方法：重要或正式的訊息還是搭配文字說清楚
化解方法：不確定對方怎麼解讀時，直接打電話或當面確認

phrases.zh: 讓對方明白自己的意思

grammar: 第一段用現在式陳述普遍現象：People use emojis because...
舉例可用 for instance/for example 帶出具體情境。
第二段用過去式敘述親友經驗，再回到現在式給建議。
小心不要用 it 指涉不清楚，講「這個表情符號」要具體寫 this emoji／the message。

from_bank.sentence: As we often grab something to eat on the way home, the line between living expenses and food blurs.
from_bank.why: the line between A and B blurs 可以改成 the line between playful teasing and sincerity often blurs when only an emoji is used，描述表情符號容易造成誤會的原因。

from_bank.sentence: All these reasons can be boiled down to the pressure of a test-oriented society.
from_bank.why: 收束句型可改成 All these misunderstandings can be boiled down to the fact that a single emoji can mean different things to different people。

from_bank.sentence: This strategy requires some short-term sacrifices but aligns with long-term goals.
from_bank.why: 可改成 This habit requires a little more effort but aligns with the goal of being clearly understood，用於化解方法的建議句。

from_bank.sentence: After all, there is no single correct answer; what matters is finding the arrangement that fits one's own life.
from_bank.why: 收尾可改成 what matters is making sure the other person reads a message the way you meant it。

common_mistakes: 用語不精準：my income management may seem quite bizarre → unconventional（bizarre 語氣太重）；people coming to participate in the game → spectators（一個字取代一串修飾語，是拉分最快的方法）

Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
固定搭配：associate to → associate A with B；participate the game → participate in the game；coerce me to turn away → coerce me into turning away
冠詞漏掉：In comparison with average Taiwanese adult → with the average Taiwanese adult；willing to allocate majority of salary → the majority of my salary
guide.model_essay: People love using emojis because they convey emotion that plain text often cannot. A simple smiley face, for instance, can soften the tone of a reminder and make it feel friendly, while a laughing emoji saves time typing out a joke. However, emojis are also a double-edged sword. Once, I sent a friend a winking face after a joke, but she took it the wrong way and thought I was being sarcastic. The line between playful teasing and sincerity often blurs when only an emoji is used. All these misunderstandings can be boiled down to the fact that a single emoji can mean different things to different people. To avoid this, I now add a short sentence to important emojis, and call the person when a message still feels unclear. This habit requires a little more effort but aligns with the goal of being clearly understood.
model_essay_used: the line between A and B blurs（The line between playful teasing and sincerity often blurs...）
All these reasons can be boiled down to N（All these misunderstandings can be boiled down to...）
This strategy requires...but aligns with...（This habit requires a little more effort but aligns with the goal...）

items.title: 公園特色圖片作文
items.prompt_zh: 不同公園樣貌與特色各異。第一段需描述圖A和圖B中公園各有何特色；第二段說明理想公園的樣貌與特色，並解釋理由。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段客觀描述圖A和圖B兩座公園各有什麼特色（例如圖A是熱鬧的兒童遊樂公園，圖B是安靜的自然生態公園），不出現「我」。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段說明你理想公園的樣貌與特色，並解釋理由，可以是結合兩種公園的優點。
ideas: 圖A公園：色彩繽紛的遊樂設施，充滿孩子的笑聲，適合親子活動
圖B公園：綠樹成蔭、有池塘和步道，適合散步放鬆、觀察生態
理想公園：希望兼具活力遊戲區和安靜綠地，滿足不同年齡層需求
理由：假日有時候想動、有時候想靜，一個公園兩種選擇最理想
理由：結合生態教育功能，讓公園不只是休閒場所也是學習場域

phrases.en: strike a balance between A and B

grammar: 第一段描述兩張圖用現在簡單式，不出現「我」。
可用 not only...but also 比較兩公園吸引的族群，注意倒裝時動詞回原形。
第二段用 In my opinion... / An ideal park should... 表態，加上 Striking a balance between A and B 說明理由。
小心冠詞：park 前面該有 a/the，不要漏掉。

from_bank.sentence: The bar chart illustrates the average monthly salary allocation of Taiwanese adults.
from_bank.why: 開場句型可改成 Picture A illustrates a lively park filled with colorful play equipment，用於第一段開場描述。

from_bank.sentence: Not only my classmates but also I was surprised by the figure.
from_bank.why: not only A but also B 可改成 Not only children but also parents are drawn to the playground in Picture A，比較兩公園的吸引族群。

from_bank.sentence: Striking a balance between work and entertainment is important for us to reap the quality of life.
from_bank.why: 可改成 Striking a balance between excitement and tranquility is what makes a park ideal for everyone，用於第二段的理想公園論述。

from_bank.sentence: As with baseball stadiums in Taiwan, the Tokyo Dome has a round roof and can accommodate tens of thousands of fans.
from_bank.why: As with N, S V 可改成 As with any shared green space, a good park should welcome visitors of every age，強調理想公園的包容性。

common_mistakes: Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
冠詞漏掉：In comparison with average Taiwanese adult → with the average Taiwanese adult；willing to allocate majority of salary → the majority of my salary
用語不精準：my income management may seem quite bizarre → unconventional（bizarre 語氣太重）；people coming to participate in the game → spectators（一個字取代一串修飾語，是拉分最快的方法）
which accounts slightly under one-third → which accounts for slightly under one-third（介係詞別漏掉）
guide.model_essay: Picture A illustrates a lively park filled with colorful play equipment, where children run and laugh while their parents watch nearby. Picture B, in contrast, shows a quieter park with a pond, walking trails, and lush greenery, attracting joggers and older visitors who simply want to relax. Not only children but also parents are drawn to the playground in Picture A, while Picture B seems to appeal more to people seeking peace after a long week. In my opinion, an ideal park should combine both qualities. Striking a balance between excitement and tranquility is what makes a park enjoyable for everyone, from toddlers who need space to run to elderly visitors who prefer a slow walk beside the water. As with any shared green space, a good park should welcome visitors of every age, offering both energy and rest.
model_essay_used: 開場句型 N illustrates...（Picture A illustrates a lively park...）
not only A but also B（Not only children but also parents are drawn to...）
Striking a balance between A and B（Striking a balance between excitement and tranquility...）

items.title: 英語授課趨勢
items.prompt_zh: 近年來，很多大學鼓勵教授以英語講授專業課程，請寫一篇英文作文，說明你對這個現象的看法。文分兩段，第一段說明你是否認同這個趨勢並陳述理由；第二段說明如果你未來就讀的大學必修課是以英語授課，你將會如何因應或規劃。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段說明你是否認同大學教授以英語授課的趨勢，並陳述理由，可以承認優缺點都有。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段說明如果未來就讀的大學必修課是英語授課，你將如何因應或提前規劃。
ideas: 立場：部分認同，因為能提早接軌國際、閱讀原文資料更直接
但也擔心：學生英語程度落差大，可能影響理解專業內容
因應規劃：提前加強學術英文字彙與聽力，多看相關領域的英文教學影片
因應規劃：上課前預習投影片生字，課後找同學討論釐清不懂之處
因應規劃：善用學校的英語資源，逐步累積用英語討論專業內容的信心
grammar: 第一段表態用 I partly agree with this trend because...
可用讓步句型呈現雙面看法：While studying in English has clear advantages, it may also disadvantage students with a weaker foundation.
第二段用未來式/would 表達因應規劃：I would make sure to.../I plan to...
小心 it 沒有指涉對象，講『這個趨勢』要用 this trend，不要只寫 it。

from_bank.sentence: This strategy requires some short-term sacrifices but aligns with long-term goals.
from_bank.why: 可改成 Taking courses in English requires some short-term struggle but aligns with the long-term goal of studying and working internationally，用於第一段的立場說明。

from_bank.sentence: I hope to become money-savvy before I step into the workplace.
from_bank.why: I hope to V before... 可改成 I hope to become comfortable with academic English before I step into a full English-taught classroom，用於第二段的規劃。

from_bank.sentence: By front-loading savings in my early career, I would give my future self more room to choose.
from_bank.why: By Ving, S V 可改成 By previewing the vocabulary in each slide beforehand, I would give myself more room to focus on the actual content in class。

from_bank.sentence: After all, there is no single correct answer; what matters is finding the arrangement that fits one's own life.
from_bank.why: 收尾可改成 what matters is preparing early enough that the language itself stops being the obstacle。

common_mistakes: 冠詞漏掉：In comparison with average Taiwanese adult → with the average Taiwanese adult；willing to allocate majority of salary → the majority of my salary
用語不精準：my income management may seem quite bizarre → unconventional（bizarre 語氣太重）；people coming to participate in the game → spectators（一個字取代一串修飾語，是拉分最快的方法）

Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
固定搭配：associate to → associate A with B；participate the game → participate in the game；coerce me to turn away → coerce me into turning away
guide.model_essay: I partly agree with the growing trend of teaching university courses in English. Taking courses in English requires some short-term struggle but aligns with the long-term goal of studying and working internationally, since students gain direct access to original research. At the same time, I worry that students with a weaker foundation might struggle to follow specialized content, which could slow their learning. If my required courses turn out to be taught in English, I would start preparing early. I hope to become comfortable with academic English before I step into a full English-taught classroom, so I plan to watch English lectures in my field over the summer. By previewing the vocabulary in each slide beforehand, I would give myself more room to focus on the actual content in class. After all, what matters is preparing early enough that the language itself stops being the obstacle.
model_essay_used: requires...but aligns with...（Taking courses in English requires...but aligns with...）
I hope to V before...（I hope to become comfortable with academic English before...）
By Ving, S V（By previewing the vocabulary in each slide beforehand...）

models.essay_en:
The past decade saw a boom of English Medium Instruction (EMI) in higher education, and I am quite optimistic about this phenomenon. For one thing, EMI courses can bring students double benefits: professional expertise and higher English proficiency; these two, taken together, give graduates competitive edges to stand out and secure coveted positions in a tough job market. Tourism, international trade, IT, sciences, academia, and banking are just a few of the job domains where English is used for communication. For another, the reasons for universities to switch to teach in English are apparent. Aside from boosting graduates’ career prospects, EMI attract brilliant international students who not only are valuable assets to the schools but generate a considerable revenue stream for the institutions. Moreover, having faculty proficient in English helps facilitate academic exchange, increase the number of research papers published in international journals, and raise the university’s world rankings. In this regard, implementing internationalization strategies such as EMI courses and global partnerships is vital for the sustainable development of a university and its students.

To better prepare myself for EMI courses, I would keep improving my English proficiency with the aid of arrays of amazing online resources. Take, for example, “ABC,” an app that I have used for 3 years. It not only arouses my interest in English but allows me to learn at any time at any place. When activating the app, I can access plenty of videos of fun topics and immerse myself in real-life English-speaking environment. Besides, the captions are interactive. When I tap on any word I don’t know, I would see an image, a short definition, or useful examples beside it, all of which accelerate my learning. Also, the app would generate oral or written tests related to the video that I have just watched so I can re-examine my understanding. What’s better, the app keeps tracking words I am learning and recommend clips for me to watch based on these words. With apps like this at hand, I have enhanced my English speaking, listening, reading and writing skills. When it comes to getting the most out of the English-taught lectures, I would make it a rule to preview and review learning materials well enough to actively participate in class activities. The more I practice English, the more automatic and natural English use becomes. In sum, I am ready to take the challenge EMI poses and look forward to the great learning experiences it would offer.
models.note: 大學堂英文參考答案（英語授課趨勢）

items.title: 踩踏花海圖片作文
items.prompt_zh: 第一段描述圖片內容，包括人、事、物及發生的事情（民眾踩踏花海）；第二段以遊客或場所主人立場，表達對這件事的看法。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段客觀描述圖片內容：遊客為了拍照走進花圃、踩踏花朵，警告標示被忽略，不要出現「我」。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段站在遊客或場地主人的立場表達看法，可以呼籲尊重規則、提出改善建議（例如設置拍照區），收尾點出公德心的重要。
ideas: 遊客為了拍出好看的照片，走進花圃中央踩踏花朵
花瓣被踩得東倒西歪，園方立的告示牌被忽略
站在花農/場地主人角度：心血被破壞感到心痛，呼籲遊客尊重規則
站在遊客角度：反省拍照該保持距離，建議設置拍照專區
呼籲：公德心比一張照片更重要，美景需要大家共同維護
grammar: 第一段客觀描述用現在簡單式或過去式，不出現「我」。
第二段表態可用 As with N, S V 帶出立場，注意前後主詞要不同、不能用 it 代替。
可用讓步句型：Tempting though a perfect photo may be, trampling the flowers crosses the line.
小心不及物動詞誤用成及物，例如 stand out 不能直接接受詞。

from_bank.sentence: The bar chart reveals some intriguing findings.
from_bank.why: N reveals... 句型可改成 The photo reveals a troubling scene: visitors stepping directly into the flower bed，用於第一段開場描述照片。

from_bank.sentence: As with baseball stadiums in Taiwan, the Tokyo Dome has a round roof and can accommodate tens of thousands of fans.
from_bank.why: As with N, S V 前後主詞不同的句型，可以改成 As with any shared public space, a flower field requires visitors to respect the same basic rules，用於表達立場句。

from_bank.sentence: Reluctant though I was to cut my entertainment budget, I did it anyway.
from_bank.why: 讓步倒裝可改成 Tempting though a perfect photo may be, no picture is worth destroying something so many people worked hard to grow。

from_bank.sentence: After all, there is no single correct answer; what matters is finding the arrangement that fits one's own life.
from_bank.why: 收尾可改成 What matters most is respecting the effort behind the scenery, not just capturing it，收掉呼籲的重點。

common_mistakes: Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
冠詞漏掉：In comparison with average Taiwanese adult → with the average Taiwanese adult；willing to allocate majority of salary → the majority of my salary
用語不精準：my income management may seem quite bizarre → unconventional（bizarre 語氣太重）；people coming to participate in the game → spectators（一個字取代一串修飾語，是拉分最快的方法）
a child who grow up → who grew up（時態要跟主詞的時間一致）
guide.model_essay: The photo reveals a troubling scene: several visitors have stepped directly into the flower bed, trampling the blossoms just to get a better photo. Petals are scattered across the soil, and a nearby warning sign asking people to stay on the path is completely ignored. As the owner of this flower field, I would feel heartbroken watching months of careful work ruined within minutes. Tempting though a perfect photo may be, no picture is worth destroying something so many people worked hard to grow. As with any shared public space, a flower field requires visitors to respect the same basic rules. I would suggest setting up a designated photo zone at the edge of the field instead. What matters most is respecting the effort behind the scenery, not just capturing it.
model_essay_used: N reveals...（The photo reveals a troubling scene...）
讓步倒裝 adj. though S V（Tempting though a perfect photo may be...）
As with N, S V（As with any shared public space...）

models.essay_en:
The annual Flower Carpet Festival was in full swing last week. Blooming flowers turned this remote town into a patchwork of vibrant colors that provided many with gorgeous backdrops for sensational photos. In the early morning, an influx of Instagram-derived visitors formed winding lines that stretched for miles outside the entrance. As the gate opened, the massive crowds surged forward and soon flooded into the fields. Some of them wandered off the designated trails and trampled on the delicate flowers in fervent search of perfect spots for photography and pleasing compositions. The others were seen dancing, jumping, lying down in the middle of the flowers, or using drones to secure the perfect selfies that they thought were destined to go viral. Still others who set their minds on bringing home some “souvenirs” were busy pulling the entire plants, roots and all, out of the ground and stealthily bagging their booty. All seemed to turn a blind eye to the big signs set up among flowerbeds that read “Enjoy the visual feast; respect our hard work!” What’s worse, the loud noise, yelling and cheering, made it nearly impossible for any visitor to enjoy the amazing scenery that unfolded before them relaxingly.

Not only did I feel deeply frustrated and annoyed by numerous selfish visitors who flattened literally everything on my land, but I was exhausted from collecting mounds of litter left behind by them. What concerned me even more was the huge economic losses resulting from their unruly behaviors; last year alone, I had three plots with NT$ 2,000,000 in damage. Not wanting to see history repeating itself, I embarked on organizing a group of "ambassadors," a team of enthusiastic volunteer guides that consisted of local retired flower farmers. To engage visitors in the rich history of floriculture in this area, enhance their outdoor knowledge and eventually raise their environmental awareness, we planned to combine floral design instruction with a field tour and discussion about growing techniques that might work like magic in the backyard. Also, we turned to some powerful influencers for help and they kindly shot clips that promoted responsible outdoor behaviors, from respecting wildlife to being considerate of farm owners and other visitors. Hopefully, by adopting these measures, we could put an end to the “nightmares” that haunted me and other flower farmers.
models.note: 大學堂英文參考答案（踩踏花海圖片作文）

items.title: 校園安全維護
items.prompt_zh: 維護校園安全是校園內每個成員的責任，請寫一篇英文作文，說明應該如何維護校園安全。文分兩段，第一段說明校園安全的重要性及校園內可能發生的安全問題；第二段說明身為校園的一份子，你覺得校內成員應該採取哪些作為以維護校園安全。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段說明校園安全的重要性，以及校園內可能發生的安全問題，例如陌生人進出、逃生通道堆放雜物。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段說明身為校園一份子，成員應該採取哪些具體作為以維護校園安全。
ideas: 重要性：安全的環境是專心學習的基礎，一旦出事會影響全校
可能問題：校門管制不嚴、陌生人隨意進出
可能問題：逃生通道堆放雜物、消防安全被忽視
作為：配戴學生證、訪客登記，養成舉報陌生人的習慣
作為：定期消防演練，同學間互相關心、通報異常狀況

phrases.en: keep an eye out for N

grammar: 第一段說明重要性可用 N is the foundation on which... 開頭。
可用 not only...but also 列出兩種安全隱患，倒裝時動詞回原形。
第二段用 should/could + 原形動詞 給建議，可搭配 by Ving 說明方法。
小心被動語態：規定『被落實』要用 rules should be enforced，不要主動被動混淆。

from_bank.sentence: One phenomenon worth discussing is that the expenses of food only make up for 19%.
from_bank.why: 句型可改成 One problem worth addressing is that visitors can sometimes walk onto campus without being noticed，用於第一段點出安全隱患。

from_bank.sentence: Not only my classmates but also I was surprised by the figure.
from_bank.why: not only A but also B 可改成 Not only strangers wandering onto campus but also blocked evacuation routes pose a real threat to student safety。

from_bank.sentence: By front-loading savings in my early career, I would give my future self more room to choose.
from_bank.why: By Ving, S V 可改成 By reporting anything unusual right away, students can give teachers more time to respond before a small issue grows，用於第二段建議。

from_bank.sentence: After all, there is no single correct answer; what matters is finding the arrangement that fits one's own life.
from_bank.why: 收尾可改成 what matters is that every member of the campus plays a part in keeping it safe。

common_mistakes: 冠詞漏掉：In comparison with average Taiwanese adult → with the average Taiwanese adult；willing to allocate majority of salary → the majority of my salary

Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
用語不精準：my income management may seem quite bizarre → unconventional（bizarre 語氣太重）；people coming to participate in the game → spectators（一個字取代一串修飾語，是拉分最快的方法）
固定搭配：associate to → associate A with B；participate the game → participate in the game；coerce me to turn away → coerce me into turning away
guide.model_essay: A safe campus is the foundation on which real learning can happen; once something goes wrong, the whole school suffers. One problem worth addressing is that visitors can sometimes walk onto campus without being noticed, since the gates are not always closely monitored. Not only strangers wandering onto campus but also blocked evacuation routes pose a real threat to student safety. As a member of this school, I believe every student has a role to play in keeping it safe. Wearing a student ID and asking visitors to register at the gate would already help. By reporting anything unusual, students can give teachers more time to respond before a small issue grows serious. Regular fire drills should also be enforced so everyone knows the evacuation route. After all, what matters is that every member of the campus plays a part in keeping it safe.
model_essay_used: One...worth Ving is that...（One problem worth addressing is that...）
not only A but also B（Not only strangers wandering onto campus but also blocked evacuation routes...）
By Ving, S V（By reporting anything unusual right away...）

models.essay_en:
Campus security and safety has long been a top priority for schools nationwide. While schools of all levels are devoted to protecting and maintaining the wellbeing of their students and faculty, they are now facing a great variety of intimidating challenges, from deadly pandemics to violent crimes. Inherently, schools may not only act as breeding grounds for contagious diseases such as colds and measles but foster their rapid transmission due to close contacts among large numbers of people, some of whom may not have developed immunity. Besides, in recent years, school districts have witnessed an increase in brutal offenses, including crimes of passion, sexual assaults and random killings. Take, for example, the murder of a four-year-old that sent shock waves through the whole society. It was reported that on the sidewalk outside an elementary school, the toddler, nicknamed Little Lightbulb, was snatched from her bike by a knife-wielding man and beheaded in full view of her mom in broad daylight. I dare not imagine what might have happened if the murderer had broken into the school. Tragedies like this outrage the public and sound the alarm on campus safety issues.

To keep schools safe, I would like to propose the following suggestions. Firstly, knowledge is power. Understanding the ways different communicable diseases spread allows us to take effective precautions. This rings true amid the recent COVID-19 crisis. Knowing that novel coronavirus is mainly transmitted between people through respiratory droplets, we responded promptly and implemented strict guidelines such as temperature taking, mask wearing, hand washing, eating in isolation and social distancing. And our efforts bring great results: Our school is still in session, providing quality learning, during the outbreak. As to preventing incidents of all kinds, be it thefts, bullying, vandalism or harassment, we can increase patrols as well as install surveillance cameras, card access systems, and electric fences to deter potential crimes. Also, holding Safety Week is a viable way to raise fellow students’ awareness of risks, promote safety tips, and cultivate a culture of shared responsibility and vigilance. Most importantly, to safeguard our campus, we are currently working on an GPS-enabled safety app that integrates emergency contacts, security escorts, an alarm, alerts and a forum to exchange intelligence into one slick, easy-to-use interface. Being able to act before a crisis can escalate is always better. And I am confident that the above-mentioned measures can help ease campus safety concerns.
models.note: 大學堂英文參考答案（校園安全維護）

items.title: 賣場週年慶圖片作文
items.prompt_zh: 觀察賣場週年慶新聞報導圖片，想像其中發生的事件或故事。第一段描述兩張圖片呈現的場景和正在發生的狀況；第二段敘述該事件接下來的發展和結果（約120字）。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段描述兩張照片呈現的場景：賣場週年慶開賣瞬間人潮蜂擁而入，接著顧客搶購折扣商品、賣場一片混亂的畫面。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段想像接下來發生的事，例如兩位顧客同時搶到最後一件特價商品發生爭執，最後在店員協調下化解，收尾帶出理性消費的省思。
ideas: 開店瞬間大批顧客衝進賣場，直奔特價區
貨架上的商品被搶購一空，走道擠得水泄不通
兩位顧客同時抓住最後一件特價外套，僵持不下
店員出面協調，其中一人讓步或提議用其他優惠彌補
收尾提醒：搶便宜之餘也別忘了基本的禮貌與耐心
grammar: 兩張圖描述用過去式，可用 The moment the doors opened 表達『一開店就…』。
用分詞構句描寫混亂畫面：Pushing past one another, shoppers rushed toward the discount racks.
第二段的衝突與化解可用 however/eventually 表轉折。
小心不及物動詞當及物用：sell out 是不及物（賣完了），不要接受詞當『把…賣完』使用。

from_bank.sentence: The moment I saw the chart, I realized my own habits were very different.
from_bank.why: The moment S V, S V 可以改成 The moment the doors opened, shoppers rushed toward the discount racks，寫開店瞬間的畫面。

from_bank.sentence: Comparing my plan with the average, I found a clear gap.
from_bank.why: Ving 分詞構句可改成 Pushing past one another, shoppers grabbed whatever they could reach，描寫搶購的混亂。

from_bank.sentence: Reluctant though I was to cut my entertainment budget, I did it anyway.
from_bank.why: 讓步倒裝可改成 Reluctant though she was to let go of the jacket, she finally agreed to share the discount，寫顧客讓步的心理轉折。

from_bank.sentence: After all, there is no single correct answer; what matters is finding the arrangement that fits one's own life.
from_bank.why: 收尾可改成 What matters is not who grabs the bargain first, but how everyone treats each other in the process。

common_mistakes: Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
倒裝／助動詞後面：did he won → did he win（動詞回原形）
a child who grow up → who grew up（時態要跟主詞的時間一致）
living（活著）／leaving（離開）搞混
guide.model_essay: The moment the doors of the department store opened for its anniversary sale, a huge crowd rushed inside, heading straight for the discount racks. Pushing past one another, shoppers grabbed whatever they could reach, and within minutes the shelves looked as if a storm had passed through. Near the coat section, two customers reached for the very last discounted jacket at the same time, and neither was willing to let go. Voices grew louder as other shoppers turned to watch the argument unfold. A staff member quickly stepped in, calmly suggesting that one of them take the jacket while the other received an extra coupon for a future purchase. Reluctant though she was at first, one woman finally agreed, and the tension melted away. What mattered in a sale like this was not who grabbed the bargain first, but how people treated each other in the rush.
model_essay_used: The moment S V, S V（The moment the doors opened...）
分詞構句 Ving 開頭（Pushing past one another, shoppers grabbed...）
讓步倒裝 adj. though S V（Reluctant though she was at first...）

models.essay_en:
The anniversary sales of Sogo Shopping Mall were in full swing. This early morning, Emily awakened her daughter, Alice, at dawn and fixed her a tasty breakfast. Then off they went, taking the MRT to their shopping heaven. Outside of the entrance, bargain hunters who were eager to lay their hands on the best-buys had formed winding lines that stretched for miles. Emily and Alice marched to join the crowd. As soon as the giant revolving door opened, Emily dragged her daughter in for fear that she would miss out on the good deals. Upon stepping inside, she saw numerous signs that read, “Buy one and get one free” and “All ninety percent off.” She couldn’t wait to start her shopping spree. Darting from shop to shop, she bought ten bags of cosmetics, five pairs of sneakers and eight skirts. With her two hands full of bulging shopping bags, she had no choice but to let go of Alice's hand, but she cautioned, “Alice, cling to the edge of my T-shirt tightly and follow me closely."

With more and more shoppers flooding in, the only connection between them was cut off. Losing sight of her mom and surrounded by crowds of complete strangers, Alice went into a panic. She scrambled to squeeze through the dense mass to look for her mom. Ten minutes into her fervent search but in vain, Alice burst out crying and let out horrible screams, "Mom, where are you? Please come pick me up. I am so scared." Her move drew passersby’s attention and a kind man walked toward her and asked, “You seem lost. Do you want me to take you to the Information Desk?’’ Wiping away the tears, Alice nodded her head in silent agreement. Upon arrival, Alice told the clerk what happened in detail and the clerk then broadcast an urgent message to prompt Emily to meet her daughter. No sooner had the broadcast been over than Emily showed up. Hearing a familiar voice calling her name, Alice looked up and saw her mom whose brows furrowed and whose face turned ghostly pale with worries and fear. Alice immediately threw herself into her mom’s arms. “Alice, I am terribly sorry. I will never let you out of my sight, especially in such a crowded place,’’ said Emily. The two finally reunited, both shedding tears of joy.
models.note: 大學堂英文參考答案（賣場週年慶圖片作文）

items.title: 青年新聞關注度圖表作文
items.prompt_zh: 右表顯示美國18至29歲的青年對不同類別之新聞的關注度統計。請依據圖表內容寫一篇英文作文，文長至少120個單詞。文分二段，第一段描述圖表內容，並指出關注度較高及偏低的類別；第二段則描述在這六個新聞類別中，你自己較為關注及較不關注的新聞主題分別為何，並說明理由。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段客觀描述圖表內容，指出美國青年關注度較高及偏低的新聞類別，不出現「我」。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段描述自己較關注和較不關注的新聞主題，並說明理由。
ideas: 圖表顯示娛樂新聞關注度最高，國際新聞關注度最低
特別現象：科技新聞關注度不低，反映年輕族群對3C／AI話題的興趣
自己較關注：科技新聞，因為跟自己興趣與未來生活相關
自己較不關注：政治新聞，因為覺得議題複雜、資訊多元不易判斷
說明理由：選擇關注跟自己生活切身相關的主題，而非全面涉獵
grammar: 第一段客觀描述圖表用現在式，可用 rank highest/lowest 表排序。
可用 in contrast/whereas 連接關注度高低的對比。
第二段轉主觀可用 Personally, I am drawn to.../ I tend to overlook...
小心主詞動詞一致與冠詞使用。

from_bank.sentence: The given chart illustrates a survey regarding how Taiwanese adults allocate their salary.
from_bank.why: 開場句型可改成 The given chart illustrates a survey regarding how young Americans allocate their attention to different news categories，直接套用做圖表開場。

from_bank.sentence: Entertainment takes up the biggest share of my budget, and other expenses pale in comparison.
from_bank.why: 可改成 Entertainment news takes up the biggest share of attention, and international news pales in comparison，用來描述圖表最大和最小類別。

from_bank.sentence: I have sufficient reasons to pour tremendous expenses into education.
from_bank.why: 可改成 I have sufficient reasons to pay closer attention to technology news, since it directly shapes the tools I will use in the future，用於第二段表態。

from_bank.sentence: After all, there is no single correct answer; what matters is finding the arrangement that fits one's own life.
from_bank.why: 收尾可改成 what matters is paying attention to the news that actually shapes the life you are building。

common_mistakes: 開頭語意重複：As can be seen in the bar chart, we can observe how... → The bar chart illustrates how...（同一句裡不要放兩個意思重複的動詞）
which accounts slightly under one-third → which accounts for slightly under one-third（介係詞別漏掉）
冠詞漏掉：In comparison with average Taiwanese adult → with the average Taiwanese adult；willing to allocate majority of salary → the majority of my salary

Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
guide.model_essay: The given chart illustrates a survey regarding how young Americans allocate their attention to different news categories. Entertainment news ranks highest at 28%, followed by sports at 20% and technology at 18%. International affairs, by contrast, ranks lowest at just 7%, suggesting that global events attract far less attention among this age group than celebrity gossip or games. Entertainment news takes up the biggest share of attention, and international news pales in comparison. Personally, my own attention skews differently. I have sufficient reasons to pay closer attention to technology news, since it directly shapes the tools I will use in the future, from AI to new apps. Political news, however, is something I tend to overlook, mainly because constant arguments between sides make it hard to know what to believe. After all, what matters is paying attention to the news that actually shapes the life you are building.
model_essay_used: 開場句 The given chart illustrates a survey regarding...（直接借用）
N takes up the biggest share..., and N pales in comparison（改寫套用）
I have sufficient reasons to V（I have sufficient reasons to pay closer attention to...）

models.essay_en:
Judging from the chart, the environment and natural disasters are the most compelling news topics for American young people aged 18 to 29 surveyed, followed by social issues and international affairs. Like no other generations, these millennials grow up with arrays of life-threatening challenges from climate crisis to poverty and terrorism, so news stories closely relevant to their daily life, wellbeing or future survival grab their attention effortlessly and keep them engaged. Besides, entertainment news and juicy celebrity gossips are also popular with these young readers, who tend to be fun-loving and trend-sensitive. They may consider such soft news the spice of life, which also helps them to smoothly blend in their peers’ conversations. However, of the six news categories, “art and culture” is the least enjoyable for these 18-to-29-year-olds. This is not great news, but it’s not altogether surprising. After all, art works can be profound and abstract, leaving viewers scratching their heads.

Speaking of my news preferences, I am drawn to coverage on environmental issues, air pollution in particular, because I have witnessed how polluted air plagued my hometown, Taichung. Long-term exposure to exhaust and toxic tiny particles emitted from coal-fired power plants, motor vehicles and factories has made many residents here fall sick from allergies, chronic cough and even lung cancer. Besides, poor air quality brings lots of inconveniences to our daily life. We dare not risk going out without wearing masks. Also, for fear of taking in excessive poisonous substances, we have no choice but to cut down on time spent on outdoor activities. It dawns on me that the earth is in a death spiral unless we take immediate action. Thus, in March, I helped launch a community campaign for clean air with friends I make on the news forum. As to the type of reports that I am more likely to skip, it would be educational news. Education policies in Taiwan change every several years, with educators, parents and students scrambling to figure out how new practices would be implemented. Thus, only when I am sure that specific policies would be applicable to me would I spend time getting familiar with them.
models.note: 大學堂英文參考答案（青年新聞關注度圖表作文）

items.title: 臺灣驕傲
items.prompt_zh: 談臺灣最讓你引以為榮的二個面向或事物（人、事、物、文化、制度等）。第一段描述這些面向並說明為何讓你驕傲；第二段說明介紹或行銷這些臺灣特色的方式。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段談台灣最讓你驕傲的兩個面向（例如全民健保和夜市文化），描述這些特色並說明為何讓你驕傲。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段說明可以怎麼介紹或行銷這些台灣特色給外國人，例如透過社群媒體短影音、邀請國際旅客實際體驗等。
ideas: 台灣的全民健保：便宜又普及，讓人不用擔心生病的醫療費用
台灣的夜市文化與小吃：多元又平價，展現濃厚人情味
台灣人的友善與熱心助人
行銷方式：拍攝短影音在社群平台分享、邀請外國網紅來體驗
行銷方式：結合美食與文化導覽，讓外國旅客親身感受
grammar: 第一段可用 What makes me proud of N is that... 帶出驕傲的理由。
可用 not only A but also B 並列兩個驕傲的面向，倒裝時動詞回原形。
第二段講行銷方式可用 could/should + 原形動詞 表建議：Taiwan could promote this through short videos on social media.
小心冠詞：講『台灣人』要注意複數與定冠詞的用法，例如 the majority of Taiwanese people。

from_bank.sentence: This arrangement reflects the priorities of career growth, financial stability, and future planning.
from_bank.why: N reflects the priorities of... 可以改成 Taiwan's healthcare system reflects the priorities of fairness and care for every citizen。

from_bank.sentence: Striking a balance between work and entertainment is important for us to reap the quality of life.
from_bank.why: Striking a balance between A and B 可以改成 Striking a balance between affordability and quality is what makes Taiwan's night markets so special。

from_bank.sentence: I aim to leverage compound interest and build a secure financial future.
from_bank.why: I aim to V and V 的句型可以改成 Taiwan could aim to leverage social media and build a stronger international image，用在第二段行銷方式。

from_bank.sentence: The chart drives me into opening my eyes to the way others spend their money, and I wish I could become money-savvy in the future.
from_bank.why: 『讓某事物帶動改變』的句型可以改成 Short videos could drive more foreigners into discovering these hidden gems for themselves。

common_mistakes: 冠詞漏掉：In comparison with average Taiwanese adult → with the average Taiwanese adult；willing to allocate majority of salary → the majority of my salary
用語不精準：my income management may seem quite bizarre → unconventional（bizarre 語氣太重）；people coming to participate in the game → spectators（一個字取代一串修飾語，是拉分最快的方法）

Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
自創字：savement → savings；recreate → recreation（不確定的字不要自己造，換一個百分之百會的字）
guide.model_essay: Two things make me especially proud of Taiwan: our universal healthcare system and our night market culture. What makes me proud of the healthcare system is that it is both affordable and accessible, so no family has to choose between paying rent and seeing a doctor. Not only does this system protect citizens' health, but it also reflects the priorities of fairness and care that define our society. Our night markets tell a similar story. Striking a balance between affordability and quality is what makes them so special, offering everything from stinky tofu to bubble tea at prices anyone can enjoy. To share these strengths with the world, Taiwan could invite international content creators to film short videos exploring our night markets and hospitals firsthand. Word of mouth from real visitors, spread through social media, would likely leave a far more lasting impression than any official advertisement ever could.
model_essay_used: not only A but also B 倒裝（Not only does this system protect...but it also reflects...）
N reflects the priorities of...（reflects the priorities of fairness and care）
Striking a balance between A and B（Striking a balance between affordability and quality...）

models.essay_en:
I am proud of Taiwan’s vast tourism resources. With its breathtaking scenery, rich cultures, fun activities, and mouth-watering delicacies, I think Taiwan has great potential to be on the ultimate travel bucket list. Take my favorite county, Hualien, for example. Nicknamed Taiwan's back garden, Hualien seems to have something for everyone. For those outdoor lovers, they can set off to Hualien Harbor, where the boats will take them out for an exciting two-hour dolphin watching trip. Seeing the naughty creatures leap high in the air, play in the waves and race with the ship is indeed an unforgettable sight. After that, they are welcome to visit the magnificent Taroko Gorge. This towering marble-walled canyon carved out by the blue-green Liwu River has long been praised as one of Asia's picturesque wonders. As for those who are fond of aboriginal culture and history, Hualien is the right place for them because it has the most concentrated tribes such as Amis or Rukai. To explore and experience the authentic tribal customs, they can join the harvest festivals taking place every summer. The highlights of the celebration include sampling the signature dishes such as roasted game meat and mochi as well as dancing with the locals to the strong beats. I am confident that tourists can satisfy their eyes, their souls and their taste buds in one trip to Hualien.

To promote Taiwan internationally, I will first suggest that the Tourism Bureau invite famous directors, star-studded cast and outstanding production teams to shoot films in Taiwan. As those films are released, Taiwan will gain lots of exposure to global audience. Better yet, the die-hard fans of the movies will become potential visitors to Taiwan. Besides, the authority can hold competitions to challenge the public to submit  five-minute short films to introduce their favorite less-traveled sites. After the result is announced, the award winners will be recruited to help tourists organize their trips. Above all, information from the travel guides, apps, maps and road signs should be up-to-date and written in different languages, free of spelling and grammatical errors. I hope that my suggestions can help keep Taiwan’s tourism booming and make touring in Taiwan unlike any other (place).
models.note: 大學堂英文參考答案（臺灣驕傲）

items.title: 舉辦社區活動方案選擇
items.prompt_zh: 如果你就讀的學校預計辦理一項社區活動，請從三個方案中選擇一項：(一)提供社區老人服務；(二)舉辦特色市集；(三)舉辦藝文活動。文分兩段，第一段說明你的選擇及原因，第二段敘述應該要有哪些活動內容，並說明設計理由。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段說明你選擇哪一項社區活動方案（示範用：特色市集）及理由。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段敘述活動內容規劃，並說明設計理由，例如動線安排、如何吸引不同年齡層。
ideas: 選擇特色市集：能吸引不同年齡層參與，也能讓在地店家有曝光機會
理由：比起單一族群受益的活動，市集能凝聚整個社區
活動內容：邀請在地小吃攤、手作攤位、學生社團表演
設計理由：動線規劃讓親子、長者都能輕鬆逛，設置休息區
設計理由：結合小型闖關遊戲，提升居民互動與參與感
grammar: 第一段表態用 I would choose N because...
可用 not only...but also 說明市集的雙重效益，倒裝時動詞回原形。
第二段描述活動設計可用 To V, S would... 表目的。
小心固定搭配：participate in（不是 participate the），及 to V 表目的時態一致。

from_bank.sentence: This arrangement reflects the priorities of career growth, financial stability, and future planning.
from_bank.why: N reflects the priorities of... 可改成 This choice reflects the priorities of inclusiveness and community spirit rather than serving just one group。

from_bank.sentence: Striking a balance between work and entertainment is important for us to reap the quality of life.
from_bank.why: 可改成 Striking a balance between fun and local support is what makes a community market worthwhile。

from_bank.sentence: Not only my classmates but also I was surprised by the figure.
from_bank.why: not only A but also B 可改成 Not only elderly residents but also young families would find something to enjoy at the market。

from_bank.sentence: After all, there is no single correct answer; what matters is finding the arrangement that fits one's own life.
from_bank.why: 收尾可改成 what matters is designing an event that brings the whole community together, not just one group of people。

common_mistakes: 冠詞漏掉：In comparison with average Taiwanese adult → with the average Taiwanese adult；willing to allocate majority of salary → the majority of my salary
固定搭配：associate to → associate A with B；participate the game → participate in the game；coerce me to turn away → coerce me into turning away

Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
用語不精準：my income management may seem quite bizarre → unconventional（bizarre 語氣太重）；people coming to participate in the game → spectators（一個字取代一串修飾語，是拉分最快的方法）
guide.model_essay: Among the three options, I would choose organizing a specialty community market. This choice reflects the priorities of inclusiveness and community spirit rather than serving just one group of residents. Not only elderly residents but also young families would find something to enjoy at the market, from local snacks to handmade crafts. To design the event well, I would invite nearby food vendors and student clubs to set up booths, while leaving space for a small stage where local performers could showcase their talent throughout the day. A designated rest area with chairs and shade would let older visitors relax between booths, and a simple stamp-collecting game could encourage children to visit every stall. Striking a balance between fun and local support is what makes a community market worthwhile. After all, what matters is designing an event that brings the whole community together, not just one group of people.
model_essay_used: N reflects the priorities of...（This choice reflects the priorities of inclusiveness...）
not only A but also B（Not only elderly residents but also young families...）
Striking a balance between A and B（Striking a balance between fun and local support...）

models.essay_en:
Given an opportunity to devise a community service project, I would opt to hold regular fairs, which serve two purposes: One is to raise people’s environmental awareness; the other is to prompt them to take immediate action to tackle air pollution. In fact, the idea for an event to focus on fighting against foul air came to my mind when I watched the viral documentary “Under the Dome” several years ago. The film, investigating the severe threat that air pollution pose, strikes an immediate chord with me because my hometown, Kaohsiung, has suffered the same problem for years. In this bustling city, air pollution has become everyone’s worst nightmare. Long-term exposure to the toxic air has made many residents here fall sick from diseases such as allergy, chronic cough or lung cancer. What's more, poor air quality brings many inconveniences to people's lives. For example, most people would not risk going out without wearing masks. Some of them even reduce outdoor activities for fear of taking in excessive, harmful substances such as PM2.5.

To help remedy this tricky issue, I would like to integrate the following activities into the events. First, with the 3Rs–reduce, reuse, and recycle–in mind, I would help organize flea markets where people can get rid of their unwanted treasures. In addition to giving a new life to those second-handed items, they are actually making great contributions to conserving virgin resources and cutting down on energy needed to manufacture new products. As less energy is generated or consumed, less greenhouse gases are emitted. Also, part of the profits gained from these events can be used to fund research in developing clean, renewable energies that lower the impact on the environment. Moreover, since exhaust from motor vehicles is a major pollution contributor, I would launch car-free campaigns to promote green transportation. Participants who walk, pedal, or take the MRT to the event would be rewarded with coupons. Hopefully, my proposed events will soon be held to place people on the path to sustainable living.
models.note: 大學堂英文參考答案（舉辦社區活動方案選擇）

items.title: 一窩蜂式的排隊現象
items.prompt_zh: 第一段以個人、親友經驗或報導為例，描述排隊情形；第二段說明對此現象的心得或感想。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段以自己或親友的經驗、報導為例，描述一次一窩蜂排隊的情形，交代人事時地物。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段轉為現在式，說明你對這種一窩蜂排隊現象的心得或感想，可以是正面看法也可以是反思。
ideas: 舉例：某家排隊名店開幕，隊伍繞了好幾圈，自己也跟著排了兩小時
親友經驗：朋友為了限量球鞋清晨五點就去排隊
心得：覺得有些排隊只是跟風，東西不一定值得等那麼久
心得：排隊也反映大家對品質與話題的重視，適度參與無妨
建議：與其盲目跟風，不如先做功課再決定要不要排
grammar: 第一段用具體經驗（過去式）描述排隊情形，要有時間地點人物細節。
第二段轉換成現在式表達看法/心得：I believe that... / This phenomenon reflects...
可用分詞構句收掉描述：Waiting for nearly three hours, I began to question whether it was worth it.
小心 phenomenon 單複數：a phenomenon（單）／phenomena（複），不要拼成 phenomena 當單數用。

from_bank.sentence: Upon closer inspection, it stands to reason that individuals are inclined to spend their wages on necessities.
from_bank.why: Upon closer inspection, it stands to reason that... 這個推論句型可以改成 Upon closer inspection, it stands to reason that people are simply afraid of missing out，用在第二段的心得分析。

from_bank.sentence: One phenomenon worth discussing is that the expenses of food only make up for 19%.
from_bank.why: One phenomenon worth discussing is that... 可以直接拿來當第二段開頭，改成談排隊現象背後的心理。

from_bank.sentence: Seeing how little others spend on education makes me green with envy.
from_bank.why: Seeing sth makes me + adj. 的句型可以改成 Seeing my friend line up at 5 a.m. for a pair of shoes made me both amused and a little envious，用來寫親友經驗。

from_bank.sentence: All these reasons can be boiled down to the pressure of a test-oriented society.
from_bank.why: 收束句型可以改成 All these reasons can be boiled down to the fear of missing out on something everyone else seems to want。

common_mistakes: Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
開頭語意重複：As can be seen in the bar chart, we can observe how... → The bar chart illustrates how...（同一句裡不要放兩個意思重複的動詞）
用語不精準：my income management may seem quite bizarre → unconventional（bizarre 語氣太重）；people coming to participate in the game → spectators（一個字取代一串修飾語，是拉分最快的方法）
a child who grow up → who grew up（時態要跟主詞的時間一致）
guide.model_essay: Last spring, a new bubble tea shop opened near my school, and the line soon stretched around the block. Curious, I joined my classmates and waited almost two hours just to try a drink everyone was talking about online. One phenomenon worth discussing is that people often queue up not for the product itself, but for the experience of being part of a trend. My friend once got up at five in the morning to line up for limited-edition sneakers, and her excitement left me both amused and a little envious. Upon closer inspection, it stands to reason that much of this behavior comes from the fear of missing out on something everyone else seems to want. Personally, I think joining in occasionally is fine, but blindly following every trend without asking whether it is worth the wait rarely pays off.
model_essay_used: One phenomenon worth discussing is that...（開頭句直接借用）
Seeing sth makes me adj.（seeing her excitement made me both amused and a little envious）
Upon closer inspection, it stands to reason that...（推論句直接借用）

models.essay_en:
Nowadays, it is not uncommon to see people line up as new crazes sweep the island in quick succession. Take the iPhone fad for example. Despite there being weeks until the iPhone X’s release, eager customers were seen setting up camps outside the flagship stores, with some professional sitters charging a huge sum to save a spot. Two days ahead of its launch, people of all ages flooded into the street, braving downpours and low temperatures to form winding lines that stretched miles and miles. Devouring pizzas delivered to the queues, they waited anxiously to get their hands on the fancy handsets to make others green with envy. Yet, days of standing in line, financially motivated consumers who planned to resell the devices to make a buck, diehard Apple fans and shortages of products put together, the results were chaos and conflict. Violent fights broke out as some opportunists cut in line. Fierce arguments erupted once shoppers competed to bag the most popular rose gold phones. Shrill cry from lost kids or customers whose valuables got stolen rang through the crowded store. Before long, the supposedly exciting shopping sprees turned sour.

As for me, I am never enthusiastic about chasing trends because they come and go like the wind. I would rather wait until the hype gradually fades so that I can get better services in a more pleasant shopping environment. Moreover, since retailers tend to offer discounts within months of the product debut to boost sales, postponing purchases allow me to enjoy the cool new stuff without draining my wallet. Lastly, avoiding “following the crowd” prevents me from falling victim to retailers’ hunger marketing and thus help cut down on impulsive buying effectively.
models.note: 大學堂英文範文（一窩蜂式排隊現象）

items.title: 寂寞時刻
items.prompt_zh: 每個人從小到大都有覺得寂寞的時刻。文分兩段，第一段說明你會因為什麼原因或在何種情境下感到寂寞，第二段描述某個人、事或物如何伴你度過寂寞時光。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段說明你會因為什麼原因或在何種情境下感到寂寞，例如剛換新環境、深夜獨自讀書時。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段描述某個人、事或物如何陪你度過寂寞時光，交代具體細節與感受。
ideas: 情境：剛轉學或搬到新環境，身邊沒有熟悉的朋友時感到寂寞
情境：半夜讀書讀到很累，身邊沒有人可以說話時
陪伴：一隻寵物安靜陪在身邊，給了安慰
陪伴：一個興趣（畫畫、音樂）成為抒發寂寞的出口
陪伴：朋友的一句簡訊或電話，讓寂寞感瞬間消散
grammar: 第一段可用 I feel loneliest when... 或 There are moments when... 開頭。
第二段描述陪伴用過去式敘述具體事件，可搭配分詞構句。
可用 The moment S V, S V 描寫陪伴帶來安慰的瞬間。
小心動詞時態一致，以及 living／leaving 拼字混淆。

from_bank.sentence: The moment I saw the chart, I realized my own habits were very different.
from_bank.why: The moment S V, S V 可改成 The moment my dog rests her head on my lap, the loneliness of the day quietly fades away。

from_bank.sentence: Reluctant though I was to cut my entertainment budget, I did it anyway.
from_bank.why: 讓步倒裝可改成 Tired though I was after studying late into the night, I still felt comforted simply having my dog beside me。

from_bank.sentence: Sitting at my desk, I opened the chart, comparing every category with my own budget.
from_bank.why: 三連續動作句型可改成 Sitting on my bed, I opened my sketchbook, letting the quiet hours turn into something worth keeping，描寫用畫畫排解寂寞的畫面。

from_bank.sentence: After all, there is no single correct answer; what matters is finding the arrangement that fits one's own life.
from_bank.why: 收尾可改成 what matters is having something, or someone, that reminds you that you are not truly alone。

common_mistakes: a child who grow up → who grew up（時態要跟主詞的時間一致）

Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
living（活著）／leaving（離開）搞混
冠詞漏掉：In comparison with average Taiwanese adult → with the average Taiwanese adult；willing to allocate majority of salary → the majority of my salary
guide.model_essay: I feel loneliest late at night, when I am still studying while the rest of the house has already gone quiet. Moving to a new school last year made it worse, since I no longer had close friends to text when the silence became heavy. During those nights, my dog has become my quiet companion. The moment she rests her head on my lap, the loneliness of the day quietly fades away, even though she cannot say a single word. Tired though I was after studying late into the night, I still felt comforted simply having her beside me. On nights when she was asleep, I would open my sketchbook instead, sitting on my bed and letting the quiet hours turn into something worth keeping. Looking back, what matters is having something, or someone, that reminds you that you are not truly alone, even in the middle of the night.
model_essay_used: The moment S V, S V（The moment she rests her head on my lap...）
讓步倒裝 adj. though S V（Tired though I was...）
分詞構句／三連續動作精神（sitting on my bed and letting the quiet hours turn into...）

items.title: 景點排隊連環圖作文
items.prompt_zh: 觀察三幅連環圖片內容（景點排隊），想像第四幅圖片的可能發展，寫一篇涵蓋每張圖片內容且結局完整的故事。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段描述前三格：熱門景點前排了長長的隊伍，遊客在大太陽下等候，有人開始不耐煩，甚至有人想插隊。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段想像第四格的結局：插隊的人被其他人禮貌但堅定地提醒後乖乖排回隊伍，最後大家順利進場，看到美景覺得等待值得。
ideas: 隊伍延伸到街角，大家頂著大太陽排隊等候
有人不耐煩想插隊，被前面排隊的人禮貌但堅定地提醒
插隊的人不好意思地回到隊伍後方重新排隊
排了將近兩小時後終於進場，眼前的美景讓大家覺得值得
收尾點出耐心和守規矩才能讓大家都盡興
grammar: 過去式敘事要一致；可用 as soon as 描寫排隊瞬間的轉折：As soon as the man tried to cut in line, the people behind him spoke up.
分詞構句可壓縮排隊的疲憊畫面：Standing under the scorching sun for nearly two hours, the tourists began to lose patience.
讓步句型可用來寫『雖然等待很久，但…』：Exhausted though they were, everyone stayed in line.
留意 it 是誰：講『這個等待』要用具體名詞如 the wait／the line，不要只寫 it。

from_bank.sentence: The moment I saw the chart, I realized my own habits were very different.
from_bank.why: The moment S V, S V 可以改成 The moment the man tried to cut in line, an elderly woman calmly reminded him of the rule，寫插隊瞬間的轉折。

from_bank.sentence: Comparing my plan with the average, I found a clear gap.
from_bank.why: Ving 分詞構句可以改成 Standing under the scorching sun, the tourists slowly began to lose patience，描寫排隊時的疲憊畫面。

from_bank.sentence: Reluctant though I was to cut my entertainment budget, I did it anyway.
from_bank.why: 讓步倒裝可以改成 Exhausted though they were, the tourists stayed patiently in line，呈現忍耐後仍守規矩的態度。

from_bank.sentence: After all, there is no single correct answer; what matters is finding the arrangement that fits one's own life.
from_bank.why: 收尾句型可以改成 What matters most is not how fast one gets in, but how fairly everyone is treated，收掉排隊插曲的寓意。

common_mistakes: Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
倒裝／助動詞後面：did he won → did he win（動詞回原形）
which accounts slightly under one-third → which accounts for slightly under one-third（介係詞別漏掉）
living（活著）／leaving（離開）搞混
guide.model_essay: At one of the city's most popular attractions, a long queue stretched around the corner as tourists waited under the scorching sun. Exhausted though they were after nearly two hours, most people stayed patiently in line, chatting quietly to pass the time. Just then, a man walked straight to the front and tried to cut in line, ignoring everyone who had been waiting. The moment he did, an elderly woman standing nearby calmly reminded him that everyone deserved a fair turn. Embarrassed, the man apologized and walked all the way back to the end of the queue. A few minutes later, the gates finally opened, and the crowd moved forward smoothly. When the tourists stepped inside and saw the breathtaking scenery, every tired minute of waiting suddenly felt worthwhile. What mattered most, they realized, was not how fast they got in, but how fairly everyone was treated.
model_essay_used: 讓步倒裝 adj. though S V（Exhausted though they were...）
The moment S V, S V（The moment he did, an elderly woman...）
收尾 what matters（What mattered most, they realized...）

items.title: 碩士清潔隊員滿街跑現象
items.prompt_zh: 最近有一則新聞報導，標題為『碩士清潔隊員滿街跑』。文分兩段，第一段依據你的觀察說明這個現象的成因，第二段則就你如何因應上述現象，具體（舉例）說明你對大學生涯的學習規劃。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段依觀察說明『碩士清潔隊員滿街跑』這個現象的成因，例如就業市場競爭激烈、公部門職缺穩定。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段說明你如何因應這個現象，具體舉例你的大學生涯學習規劃，例如提早累積實務經驗。
ideas: 成因：部分科系畢業生就業市場競爭激烈，公部門職缺穩定、福利好
成因：社會對『學歷等於好工作』的既定印象與現實job market有落差
因應規劃：大學時期多修實務課程、爭取實習機會
因應規劃：培養一技之長或證照，不只依賴學位本身
因應規劃：重視能力與興趣的媒合，而非只看學歷高低

phrases.en: a mismatch between N and N
bridge the gap between A and B

grammar: 第一段用現在式分析現象成因，可用 One phenomenon worth discussing is that... 開頭。
可用 not only...but also 並列兩個成因，倒裝時動詞回原形。
第二段用未來式或 would 表達規劃：I would make sure to..., I plan to...
小心 phenomenon 單複數，以及 it 沒有指涉對象。

from_bank.sentence: One phenomenon worth discussing is that the expenses of food only make up for 19%.
from_bank.why: 句型可改成 One phenomenon worth discussing is that graduate degree holders are taking jobs that do not require a degree at all，直接切入這個社會現象。

from_bank.sentence: All these reasons can be boiled down to the pressure of a test-oriented society.
from_bank.why: 可改成 All these reasons can be boiled down to a mismatch between academic credentials and the actual job market，用於歸納成因。

from_bank.sentence: By front-loading savings in my early career, I would give my future self more room to choose.
from_bank.why: By Ving, S V 可改成 By gaining hands-on experience early in college, I would give my future self more options to choose from，用於第二段的規劃。

from_bank.sentence: After all, there is no single correct answer; what matters is finding the arrangement that fits one's own life.
from_bank.why: 收尾可改成 what matters is finding work that matches one's actual skills and interests, not just a diploma。

common_mistakes: 冠詞漏掉：In comparison with average Taiwanese adult → with the average Taiwanese adult；willing to allocate majority of salary → the majority of my salary
用語不精準：my income management may seem quite bizarre → unconventional（bizarre 語氣太重）；people coming to participate in the game → spectators（一個字取代一串修飾語，是拉分最快的方法）

Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
開頭語意重複：As can be seen in the bar chart, we can observe how... → The bar chart illustrates how...（同一句裡不要放兩個意思重複的動詞）
guide.model_essay: One phenomenon worth discussing is that graduate degree holders are increasingly taking jobs, such as street cleaning, that do not require an advanced degree at all. This trend partly stems from a job market that is oversaturated in certain academic fields, while public-sector positions like sanitation work offer the security and stable income many young graduates now crave. All these reasons can be boiled down to a mismatch between academic credentials and what the actual job market needs. To avoid facing the same mismatch myself, I plan to use my college years differently. Rather than focusing only on grades, I intend to take practical courses and apply for internships every summer. By gaining hands-on experience early, I would give my future self more options to choose from after graduation. After all, what matters is finding work that matches one's actual skills and interests, not simply holding a diploma.
model_essay_used: One...worth discussing is that...（直接借用）
All these reasons can be boiled down to N（改寫：a mismatch between academic credentials...）
By Ving, S V（By gaining hands-on experience early...）

items.title: 家事分工
items.prompt_zh: 第一段說明對家事分工的看法及理由；第二段舉例說明家中家事分工情形，並描述做家事的經驗及感想。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段說明你對家事分工的看法及理由，例如認為家事應該按照每個人的時間與能力一起分擔，而不是只靠一個人。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段舉例說明你家實際的家事分工情形，描述自己做家事的經驗與感想，語氣可以從一開始覺得麻煩，轉變成有所體會。
ideas: 認為家事該按照能力與時間分工，不是只有媽媽或某一人做
舉例：自己負責倒垃圾、洗碗，弟弟負責摺衣服，爸媽分擔煮飯打掃
做家事的經驗：一開始覺得麻煩，後來發現能訓練責任感
感想：一起做家事讓家裡氣氛更好，也更能體會家人的辛苦
把做家事當作提前練習生活技能，對未來獨立生活有幫助
grammar: 第一段陳述看法可用 I believe that... / In my opinion, household chores should be shared by every family member.
第二段描述經驗宜用過去式或現在完成式：I have been in charge of taking out the trash since I was ten.
可用 not only...but also 列出自己負責的多項家事，注意句首倒裝時動詞要回原形。
小心 it 沒有指涉對象：講『這件事』要用 doing chores／this task 等具體名詞，不要只寫 it。

from_bank.sentence: Striking a balance between work and entertainment is important for us to reap the quality of life.
from_bank.why: Striking a balance between A and B 可以改成 Striking a balance between schoolwork and household chores is important for building responsibility，用在第一段的看法句。

from_bank.sentence: This arrangement reflects the priorities of career growth, financial stability, and future planning.
from_bank.why: N reflects the priorities of... 可以改寫成 This arrangement reflects our family's shared belief that everyone should contribute，說明家事分工反映的價值觀。

from_bank.sentence: By front-loading savings in my early career, I would give my future self more room to choose.
from_bank.why: By Ving, S V 的句型可以改成 By taking on these small chores early, I am learning skills my future self will need，把做家事跟未來連結。

from_bank.sentence: After all, there is no single correct answer; what matters is finding the arrangement that fits one's own life.
from_bank.why: 收尾可以改成 what matters is finding a division of labor that fits each family，呼應家事分工沒有標準答案。

common_mistakes: a child who grow up → who grew up（時態要跟主詞的時間一致）

Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
冠詞漏掉：In comparison with average Taiwanese adult → with the average Taiwanese adult；willing to allocate majority of salary → the majority of my salary
用語不精準：my income management may seem quite bizarre → unconventional（bizarre 語氣太重）；people coming to participate in the game → spectators（一個字取代一串修飾語，是拉分最快的方法）
guide.model_essay: In my opinion, household chores should be shared by every family member, not left to just one parent. Everyone under the same roof should contribute according to their time and ability. In my family, this belief is put into practice weekly: not only do I take out the trash, but I also wash the dishes after dinner, while my brother folds the laundry and my parents take turns cooking and cleaning. At first, I found these tasks annoying and complained about losing study time. Over time, however, I noticed how tired my parents looked after work, and doing my share made me feel like a real contributor, not a guest in my own home. By taking on these chores early, I am learning skills my future self will need. This arrangement reflects our family's belief that responsibility, not convenience, should decide who does what.
model_essay_used: not only A but also B 倒裝（not only do I take out the trash, but I also wash...）
By Ving, S V（By taking on these small chores early, I am learning...）
N reflects the priorities of...（This arrangement reflects our family's shared belief...）

items.title: 指導別人學習的經驗
items.prompt_zh: 根據你過去幫助別人學習，或得到別人的指導而學會某件事的經驗，寫一篇至少120個單詞的英文作文。文分兩段，第一段說明該次經驗的緣由、內容和過程，第二段說明你對該次經驗的感想。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段說明一次指導別人學習（或被別人指導）的緣由、內容和過程，交代時間地點人物，例如教同學解開一直不懂的數學單元。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段說明對這次經驗的感想，例如發現教別人也能加深自己的理解，或耐心和換句話說的能力很重要。
ideas: 緣由：同學某單元一直不懂，自己主動提出要教他
過程：用簡單的例子和圖解慢慢拆解概念，反覆練習到他真的懂
感想：教別人的過程中自己也把觀念想得更清楚
感想：發現耐心和換句話說的能力，比直接給答案更重要
延伸：這次經驗讓自己更有信心面對需要說明複雜概念的場合

phrases.en: break sth down into simple steps

grammar: 第一段用過去式敘述事情經過，交代時間地點人物。
可用 Upon Ving 或 The moment S V, S V 描寫關鍵轉折，例如同學終於聽懂的瞬間。
第二段轉現在完成式表達長期感想：This experience has taught me that...
全篇動詞時態要一致，注意過去式的規則與不規則變化。

from_bank.sentence: The moment I saw the chart, I realized my own habits were very different.
from_bank.why: The moment S V, S V 可改成 The moment I explained the idea with a simple diagram, his face lit up with understanding，寫同學恍然大悟的瞬間。

from_bank.sentence: Comparing my plan with the average, I found a clear gap.
from_bank.why: Ving 分詞構句可改成 Breaking the problem down into smaller steps, I found a way to explain it that finally made sense to him。

from_bank.sentence: I have sufficient reasons to pour tremendous expenses into education.
from_bank.why: I have sufficient reasons to V 可改成 I have sufficient reasons to believe that teaching someone else is one of the best ways to learn，用於第二段的感想。

from_bank.sentence: After all, there is no single correct answer; what matters is finding the arrangement that fits one's own life.
from_bank.why: 收尾可改成 what matters is finding an explanation that fits how the other person thinks，呼應教學過程中因材施教的體會。

common_mistakes: a child who grow up → who grew up（時態要跟主詞的時間一致）

Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
冠詞漏掉：In comparison with average Taiwanese adult → with the average Taiwanese adult；willing to allocate majority of salary → the majority of my salary
固定搭配：associate to → associate A with B；participate the game → participate in the game；coerce me to turn away → coerce me into turning away
guide.model_essay: Last semester, one of my classmates kept struggling with a geometry unit no matter how the teacher explained it. Since I understood the concept fairly well, I offered to walk him through it after school. Breaking the problem down into smaller steps, I found a way to explain it that finally made sense to him, using shapes instead of abstract formulas. The moment I explained the idea with a simple diagram, his face lit up with understanding, and he solved the next three problems almost on his own. I have sufficient reasons to believe that teaching someone else is one of the best ways to learn, because explaining it forced me to understand it fully myself. This experience also taught me patience: what matters is finding an explanation that fits how the other person thinks, not repeating the textbook.
model_essay_used: Ving 分詞構句（Breaking the problem down into smaller steps...）
The moment S V, S V（The moment I explained the idea...）
I have sufficient reasons to V（I have sufficient reasons to believe that...）

items.title: 兩本書二選一之閱讀想像
items.prompt_zh: 根據兩本書的書名想像其內容並選擇其中一本。第一段說明選擇哪一本及認為該書內容為何；第二段提出選擇該書的理由。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段先講你選了哪一本書（示範用書名：A Thousand Doors 和 The Silent Ocean 二選一），用書名去合理想像可能的故事內容或主題，把你想像的內容說清楚。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段講你選這本書而不選另一本的理由：可能是書名引發的好奇心、想探索的主題、或跟自己興趣的連結，舉一兩個具體理由。
ideas: 選『A Thousand Doors』，想像是一個關於平行世界或人生選擇的奇幻故事
選『The Silent Ocean』，想像是一個關於海洋保育或內心平靜的故事
理由：書名讓人好奇每一道門後面是什麼，呼應自己對未知的興趣
理由：另一本書名聽起來偏向平靜溫和，但自己更喜歡有想像空間、留白的故事
把書名和自己的個性/興趣連結，讓理由更具體不空泛
grammar: 第一段先表態選哪本書，再用推測語氣描述內容，可用 I imagine that... / It seems to be a story about...
第二段的理由句要具體，避免空泛：可用 What draws me to N is that... 帶出理由。
可用 not only A but also B 呈現雙重理由，例如書名不只吸引人，還跟自己的興趣呼應。
小心不要用 it 代替書名卻沒有先講清楚指的是哪一本。

from_bank.sentence: I hope to become money-savvy before I step into the workplace.
from_bank.why: I hope to V before... 的句型可以改成 I hope to read more stories like this before I graduate，表達對這本書主題的期待。

from_bank.sentence: Becoming a professional food taster tops my bucket list.
from_bank.why: sth tops my bucket list 這個句型可以改成 Reading a story about parallel worlds tops my reading list，把『想讀』講得更有畫面感。

from_bank.sentence: All these reasons can be boiled down to the pressure of a test-oriented society.
from_bank.why: All these reasons can be boiled down to N 這個收束句型很適合總結選書的理由：All these reasons can be boiled down to my love for stories that leave room for imagination。

from_bank.sentence: After all, there is no single correct answer; what matters is finding the arrangement that fits one's own life.
from_bank.why: 收尾邏輯可以改成 After all, there is no wrong choice between the two books; what matters is which one speaks to you，收掉『二選一』的主題。

common_mistakes: 冠詞漏掉：In comparison with average Taiwanese adult → with the average Taiwanese adult；willing to allocate majority of salary → the majority of my salary
自創字：savement → savings；recreate → recreation（不確定的字不要自己造，換一個百分之百會的字）
用語不精準：my income management may seem quite bizarre → unconventional（bizarre 語氣太重）；people coming to participate in the game → spectators（一個字取代一串修飾語，是拉分最快的方法）

Compared with regular work days, it's third the amount of people coming to participate the game. → On holidays, the game attracts three times the number of spectators it does on regular work days.（只要打出 it／it's，先停下來問一次「it 是誰？」句子裡找不到，就換成一個真正的名詞）
guide.model_essay: Between the two books, I would choose A Thousand Doors. Judging from the title, I imagine a story about a girl who discovers a hallway of doors, each leading to a different version of her own life. The plot would follow her as she opens door after door, learning which choices truly matter and which she can let go of. This idea sparks my curiosity far more than a title suggesting a calm, silent sea. What draws me to this book is that it leaves room for imagination instead of handing me a clear answer. I often wonder what my life would look like if I had made different choices, so a story built around parallel possibilities resonates with me. All these reasons can be boiled down to my love for stories that make readers pause and reflect on their own doors.
model_essay_used: sth tops my bucket list（精神改寫：a story that sparks my curiosity）
All these reasons can be boiled down to N（All these reasons can be boiled down to my love for...）
收尾 what matters is...（改寫精神呼應二選一的收尾邏輯）

items.title: 美國高中生時間分配圖表作文
items.prompt_zh: 下圖呈現的是美國某高中的全體學生每天進行各種活動的時間分配。文分兩段，第一段描述該圖所呈現之特別現象；第二段請說明整體而言，你一天的時間分配與該高中全體學生的異同，並說明其理由。

guide.structure_p1: 第一段客觀描述圖表所呈現的美國高中生每天活動時間分配，指出其中一個特別的現象，不出現「我」。
guide.structure_p2: 第二段說明整體而言，自己一天的時間分配與該圖表的異同，並說明理由。
ideas: 圖表顯示美國高中生睡眠佔最大比例，其次是在校時間
特別現象：休閒／看螢幕的時間比例意外偏高，甚至高於做作業的時間
比較：自己花在功課和讀書的時間比圖表中的美國學生多一些
比較：自己的睡眠時間和圖表中的比例接近，說明睡眠對雙方都很重要
相同處：休閒和社交時間在兩邊都占有一定份量，顯示放鬆對學生同樣必要

phrases.en: strike a balance between A and B
make the most of one's time

grammar: 第一段客觀描述圖表用現在式，不出現「我」，可用 The chart illustrates.../reveals...
可用 account for + 百分比 報數據，followed by 表排序。
第二段轉主觀可用 In comparison, my own schedule... / Unlike the students in the chart, I...
小心主詞動詞一致，例如 which accounts for（不是 account）。

from_bank.sentence: The bar chart illustrates the average monthly salary allocation of Taiwanese adults.
from_bank.why: 開場句型可直接套用，改成 The chart illustrates the average daily time allocation of American high school students，是最貼切的圖表開場句。

from_bank.sentence: The bar chart reveals some intriguing findings.
from_bank.why: 可直接用在描述完數據後的轉折句，帶出『休閒時間比作業時間長』這個特別現象。

from_bank.sentence: The way I spend my money is a far cry from what is presented in the graph.
from_bank.why: 可以改成 The way I spend my afternoons is a far cry from what is presented in the chart，用於第二段開頭的『我跟圖表不一樣』宣告句。

from_bank.sentence: After all, there is no single correct answer; what matters is finding the arrangement that fits one's own life.
from_bank.why: 收尾可直接借用改寫，說明時間分配沒有標準答案，只有適合自己的安排。

common_mistakes: 開頭語意重複：As can be seen in the bar chart, we can observe how... → The bar chart illustrates how...（同一句裡不要放兩個意思重複的動詞）
